notes.title: Early Access Version 1.0.2 - Silverstone Pit Garage Update
notes.content:
Update Size - 698.5MB / BuildID 20114916

Welcome to our second patch under Early Access, and this one is a bigger update than ea1.0.1, including multiple general visual improvements across all maps, bar Kiev Central, and the expansion of Silverstone in the form of 3 Pit Garages (each of which have a new collectible and achievement).



Weiner Town:

Added a Pickle... don't ask.

Replaced and Optimised Video Van

Replaced Grass Textures

Updated the Roadmap banner



Silverstone:

Added 3 Pit Garages, all with a new collectible each

Removed branding from tents



Bus Station:

Added exterior windowsills to Bus Station

Fixed broken brake lights on Vans

Lowered Bus Station Sidegate Road

Removed a van on London Road (off-map but visible)



Bike Depot:

Added EOML boards to Van Car Park

Added Flooring to McDonald’s

Replaced shops entirely with custom ones

notes.title: JGWS - Steam Next Fest Announcement
notes.content:
JoshGeoff Weiner Simulator Demo Arrives for Steam Next Fest – June 9–16! 

Hey everyone!

We’re beyond excited to announce that the Demo for JoshGeoff Weiner Simulator will be available as part of Steam Next Fest, running from June 9 to June 16! This is your first chance to step into the beautifully bizarre world of JoshGeoff Weiner Simulator, set in the grungy sites of the UK. 


What to Expect in the Demo:
- The first map of Weiner Town, a grungy portside subarb of the main city.
- All collectibles of Weiner Town as it will be on Early Access Release.


When & Where:
- Demo goes live on June 9, 2025 at 6PM BST.
- Available through Steam Next Fest.
- Playable through June 16th - do NOT miss out on the next achievement-based game.


Help Us Improve JGWS
As JGWS is developed solely by one guy... me. It would be much appreciated if you join our Discord Server and build up our community, report bugs and give your feedback/suggestions in the correct channels. 


Stream Schedules??
During Steam Next Fest, we'll continue dropping short-form content across our socials, and even have our content creators AND ourselves stream during the Demo! This gives you the opportunity to gather secrets, answer questions and see behind the scenes.

notes.title: Beta Version 1.3.3
notes.content:

This update is mostly additions to our first two maps, Weiner Town and Kiev Central; with the main update being focused on the Weiner Town Central Park Achievements + Weiners being added in.

Update Size - 6.4MB / BuildID 17987862
GLOBAL:


[olist]
 Bike Depot map select displays as 'Coming Soon'

Weiner Town


 Added Weiners in Central Park


 Added Achievements + Icons for new Weiners


 Reversed Traffic Directions

 (Some were driving on the Left, some were driving on the Right. All vehicles should now be driving on the Left). 


 Added Parking Spots for the Taxi Rank + Fences & Posts

Kiev Central



 Added Oyster Touchpads at Platform 1 Exit


 Fixed void over Platform 2 fences into the city

 (Grass/Pavements/Roads that were previously not seen.)



Retextured Platform 1 & 2 UKTP Posters

Bus Station

 (They didn’t want to break their neck looking at the traffic light).


Other
